title: Master Plan — Crucible-Improve Follow-up (live-use fixes, 2026-07-01)
claims: ## Master Plan — Crucible-Improve Follow-up (live-use fixes, 2026-07-01)
**North Star**
Close the three real gaps John found while dogfooding the just-built crucible-improve (W1–W9) branch, without regressing anything that already works — each wave truth-gated by the full pytest suite.

**Claude-first session launch** — dashboard session-launch controls hardcoded `backend:'gemini'`, which opened research in Gemini and landed the researchPrime seed on a Gemini PTY that can't load a Claude Code skill (so researchPrime never auto-loaded). Fix: default every launch control to Claude, honoring the locked model policy (Claude default; 5:1 Gemini split stays at the skill/session layer; Gemini reachable only via the explicit per-session toggle).

**Unified dock controls** — the v12 bottom dock still carried the pre-W6 control shape (`✕` close + a separate red `✕` true-delete + a text "Kill → Boneyard"). Fix: collapse to match the W6-unified inline panel — exactly `×` (graceful close, keeps the effort) + `🪦` (the one destructive Kill → Boneyard); remove the redundant second `✕`.

**Bridge job cost onto the effort record** — time/tokens/spend read all-zero because the only writer of the effort `cost` block (`finalize_effort` → `attach_cost`) had no production caller; the runner captured real cost on the *job* record but never bridged it to the *effort* pointer-record the rollups read. Fix: wire that bridge for one-shot `launch_lane` jobs.
Python stdlib only at runtime (pytest dev-only); no new deps.
The three fixes only — no adjacent refactors or taste changes.
Every wave GREEN via the orchestrator-run full pytest gate before commit; the UI wave additionally requires a screenshot sign-off from John.
**Documented out-of-scope limitation**

Wave 3 gives one-shot `launch_lane` jobs real cost, but interactive ConPTY terminal sessions transport raw PTY bytes with no stream-json `result` envelope — so they have no machine-readable token/cost and will keep contributing 0 to the rollup; fixing that needs a separate mechanism, not in this effort.
## Implementation Plan — four contiguous waves
Each wave: EXECUTE → orchestrator GATE (`python -m pytest -q`) → adversarial REVIEW → FIX → re-gate → commit-on-GREEN.

**Wave 1 — Claude-first launch** (`anchor_gui.py`): flip `newTermSession` and `newEffort` defaults from `'gemini'` to `'claude'`; replace the research-lane dual "(Gemini)" launchers with a single "+ New research run" Claude launcher. Acceptance: no launch site hardcodes `'gemini'`, lane→skill seed mapping unchanged, gated by `tests/test_claude_first_launch_w1.py`.

**Wave 2 — Unified dock controls** (`_render_layoutd_dock_html`) [UI — screenshot sign-off]: keep `dockMin/dockMax/dockAdvance/dockClose`, convert `dockKill` to the `🪦` headstone, remove the `dockDelete` element with no dangling erroring reference. Gated by `tests/test_dock_controls_unified_w2.py` plus John's screenshot confirmation.

**Wave 3 — Cost bridge** (`job_runner.py`): in `_finalize`, when the job carries a project effort identity, bridge cost via a lazy-imported `effort_history.finalize_effort(..., auto_commit=False)` — best-effort try/except, idempotent, no git commit from finalization. A job with no effort identity finalizes exactly as before. Gated by `tests/test_cost_bridge_w3.py`.

**Wave 4 — Triage & fix baseline reds** (added beyond the Master Plan's three): the branch carried ~59 pre-existing full-suite failures; this wave runs last to bring the whole suite GREEN (or GREEN minus an enumerated, John-agreed environmental set). Categories: realign stale W6/W9 control-scheme tests to the unified `×`+`🪦` scheme (alignment, not test-weakening — coverage must not drop), gate genuinely environment-bound Playwright/live-server tests behind `importorskip`/explicit-reason skips, and fix real regressions rather than mask them. Every touched test logged with category + action + citation.

Note the plan grew from the Master Plan's **three fixes/waves** to a **four-wave** Implementation Plan — Wave 4 (baseline-red triage) was added at implementation-planning time to reach a truly-GREEN end state.
